statement.en: forall emp1 emp2, (forall x, not x in emp1) -> (forall x, not x in emp2) -> emp1 = emp2
statement.ja: forall emp1 emp2, (forall x, not x in emp1) -> (forall x, not x in emp2) -> emp1 = emp2

script: theorem empty_unique : forall emp1 emp2, (forall x, not x in emp1) -> (forall x, not x in emp2) -> emp1 = emp2.

explanation.en:
As a culmination of the lessons so far, let us prove the uniqueness of the empty set.

We say that a set emp is empty when it satisfies

forall x, not x in emp

The goal is to show that if two sets emp1 and emp2 are empty, then they are equal.

There are no hints. Try to prove it yourself using what you have learned.
explanation.ja:
このレッスンでは今までの集大成として，「空集合の一意性」を証明しましょう．集合 emp が空集合であるとは，

forall x, not x in emp

をみたすときに言います．今回のゴールは「2つの集合emp1, emp2が空集合なら，それらは等しい」を示すことです．

ヒントはありません．これまの知識を使って自分で証明してみましょう．
